definitions.explanation: A flat fish that lies on the sea bed with both eyes on one side of its head, the right side in the case of カレイ. A common, inexpensive white fish, usually simmered or fried.

examples.japanese: カレイ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮付|につ}け→煮付け：18831_nitsuke⟧。
⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夕飯|ゆうはん}→夕飯：02981_yuuhan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧カレイ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧だ。

examples.english: As the saying "left hirame, right karei" goes, the one with its eyes on the right is karei.

notes:
Usually written in katakana; the kanji spelling is {鰈|かれい}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カレイ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮付|につ}け→煮付け：18831_nitsuke⟧: flounder simmered in soy sauce and sugar
- カレイ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{唐揚|からあ}げ→唐揚げ：04949_karaage⟧: deep-fried flounder
- ⟦{子持|こも}ち→子持ち：12303_komochi⟧ガレイ: flounder full of roe (the カ becomes ガ in compounds)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ヒラメ→ヒラメ：11135_hirame⟧: left-eyed flatfish (olive flounder) — pricier, prized as sashimi. Lay the fish belly down facing you: ⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧⟦ヒラメ→ヒラメ：11135_hirame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧カレイ

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse it with ⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧ (curry), which has a long vowel, or with the homophones ⟦{加齢|かれい}→加齢：11821_karei⟧ (aging) and ⟦{華麗|かれい}→華麗：09199_karei⟧ (splendid).
